exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

I prefer simple ingredients. Which brand should I choose, and why?
reviewed_answer:
If you want the cleanest, simplest ingredient list, Good Culture Organic Whole Milk Cottage Cheese is the strongest choice because it contains only milk, cream, sea salt, and live cultures while avoiding gums and stabilizers.
In short: Good Culture consistently ranks highest for clean labels, organic sourcing, and minimal ingredients across multiple expert reviews 
.
✅ Why Good Culture is the top pick
Ultra‑simple ingredients: just organic milk, cream, sea salt, and live cultures 
.
No gums, thickeners, or preservatives—a key priority for clean‑label shoppers 
.
Pasture‑raised, organic dairy, which improves both flavor and sourcing transparency 
.
Added probiotics for natural tang and digestive benefits 
.
Top taste ranking: It was the #1 overall winner in a 22‑brand taste test 
.
If your priority is “simple and clean,” this brand aligns perfectly.
🥈 Strong alternatives if Good Culture isn’t available
These brands also keep ingredients minimal and avoid unnecessary additives:
Daisy Cottage Cheese — Just milk, cream, salt, and cultures; widely available and budget‑friendly 
.
Organic Valley Cottage Cheese — Organic, pasture‑raised milk with a short ingredient list and no stabilizers 
.
Kalona SuperNatural Organic Cottage Cheese — Grass‑fed, minimally processed, and made only with milk, cream, salt, and cultures 
.
Nancy’s Organic Cottage Cheese — Clean ingredients plus probiotics; tangier flavor profile 
.
